google.name: Google Play supported devices
google.note: Factual Retail Branding, Model and Marketing Name relationships. No Device codename matching, specifications or images. The upstream URL is mutable; ordinary builds use the bundled derived snapshot. Android entries also include tablets, TVs and other devices, not exclusively phones.

apple.name: DeviceKit hardware identifier names
apple.note: Literal iPhone/iPad/iPod hardware identifier/name pairs from the maintainer's catalogue; not an Apple attestation. The upstream template is parsed as data and never executed.
